    order_date,variety,ordered,refunded

plugs that still have to go out, followed by a NET line:

    <variety>,<plugs>
    NET,<plugs>

The wholesale portal records returned trays in the refunded column as a
plain count on the same scale as ordered; that count comes back off the
variety's total before the line is printed.
"""
